items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: This Dickey Nelson that plays with Scobie today can go that high.

ctx.x: Yeah, I guess some of those bebop trombone flats can go that high. Yeah, C. Can't. They have funny mouthpieces and everything.
This Dickey Nelson that plays with Scobie today can go that high. They were really…
Noor was really good. He could sing high, very high. Eddie Atkin could sing high. Well, Ory wasn't too high, but he had plenty of stuff with the Chino.
